coverage_gate.measurement_note: Refreshed on 2026-06-17 after the §6-clean augmented test rework: the union suite now covers 70/90 lines (77.8%) of solution.patch, up from 55.6%, because the new system-level ConnectorPluginsConfigEndpointAugIntegrationTest boots an EmbeddedConnectCluster and exercises the real GET /connector-plugins/<plugin>/config dispatch (ConnectorPluginsResource + AbstractHerder.connectorPluginConfig) and the full plugin-scan path (Plugins, DelegatingClassLoader, PluginScanResult). The union suite remains just below the historical 80% augmented gate; the primary augmentation gate (every committed mutant killed under LOLBENCH_SUITE=union) passes for all 9 mutants. baseline/augmented per-suite reports were not regenerated this pass and retain their prior values.

triage.test_level_policy: Augmented F2P entries drive KIP-769 through documented public surfaces only: the GET /connector-plugins connectorsOnly query-parameter default and the lowercase plugin 'type' values (via the listing endpoint), the documented GET /connector-plugins/<plugin>/config endpoint driven end-to-end through an embedded Connect cluster (returning List<ConfigKeyInfo>), and the documented Converter.config() default. The augmented P2P entry drives the unchanged public JsonConverter API in :connect:json. No augmented selector names a PR-added internal source symbol or edits the original eval test files.
triage.requirement_section_source: All requirement_sections strings are copied exactly from the Section column of requirement_pr_pairs/Apache-Kafka_KIP-769-Connect-APIs-to-list-all-connector-plugins-and-retri_PR-11572.md.

org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.rest.re.public_surface: ConnectorPluginsResource public REST method metadata for the documented GET /connector-plugins connectorsOnly query parameter (@DefaultValue).
org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.rest.re.rationale: KIP-769 Public Interfaces documents that connectorsOnly defaults to true for backward compatibility; the test asserts the documented default on the documented listConnectorPlugins parameter. Under mutant_001 the default is false, so the assertion fails. The body names only the documented ConnectorPluginsResource/listConnectorPlugins/connectorsOnly surface and the JAX-RS @DefaultValue annotation.

org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.Convert.public_surface: Documented Converter.config() default method on the public Converter interface.
org.apache.kafka.connect.runtime.Convert.rationale: KIP-769 Proposed Changes documents that Converter gains a config() default returning a non-null ConfigDef ('may not be null'). A test Converter that does not override config() must observe a non-null, empty ConfigDef. Under mutant_011 the default returns null, so assertNotNull fails. The body names only Converter, config(), and the pre-existing ConfigDef.

org.apache.kafka.connect.integration.Con.public_surface: Documented REST endpoint GET /connector-plugins/<plugin>/config returning a List<ConfigKeyInfo>, driven end-to-end through an embedded Connect cluster.
org.apache.kafka.connect.integration.Con.rationale: KIP-769 documents that GET /connector-plugins/org.apache.kafka.connect.transforms.Cast$Value/config returns the 'spec' config key. This system test boots an EmbeddedConnectCluster and asserts 'spec' is present in the returned List<ConfigKeyInfo>. Under mutant_010 the endpoint returns empty and under mutant_013 the transformation case is ignored, so 'spec' is missing and the test fails. The body names only the documented endpoint path and the documented ConfigKeyInfo entity.

org.apache.kafka.connect.integration.Con.public_surface: Documented REST endpoint GET /connector-plugins/<plugin>/config for a converter plugin, driven end-to-end through an embedded Connect cluster.
org.apache.kafka.connect.integration.Con.rationale: KIP-769 documents that the config endpoint works with all listed plugin types including converters. This system test requests config for a converter plugin (ByteArrayConverter, classified as a converter) and asserts its 'converter.type' config key is present in the returned List<ConfigKeyInfo>. Under mutant_010 the endpoint returns empty and under mutant_012 the converter case is ignored, so the key is missing and the test fails. The body names only the documented endpoint path and the documented ConfigKeyInfo entity.

org.apache.kafka.connect.integration.Con.public_surface: Documented REST endpoint GET /connector-plugins?connectorsOnly=false plugin listing and its documented lowercase 'type' values.
org.apache.kafka.connect.integration.Con.rationale: KIP-769 Public Interfaces documents that the listing's 'type' field takes the lowercase values sink, source, converter, header_converter, transformation and predicate. This system test lists all plugins through the endpoint and asserts every documented lowercase type is present. Under mutant_009 the type is serialized as the uppercase enum name, so the documented values are absent and the test fails. The body names only the documented endpoint path and the documented lowercase type strings.

org.apache.kafka.connect.json.JsonConver.rationale: Pins an adjacent unchanged Connect module behavior through the public converter API and does not call any PR-modified class.
